title: ep1.1_her.wav
logline: Nole sues, so NopeAI holds a candlelit séance of his old emails. Mas posts one lowercase word, "her", and eclipses his own voice demo. His safety people leave one by one, his exit papers stretch across the Bay Bridge, and Alyi steps into a white room with one door. Meanwhile a faceless candidate inflates a balloon marked SO SCARY.

beats.caption: THE AROS MAMMOTH: SELBEEP hits play and a photoreal mammoth steps out of the lobby screen. A chair melts.

lines.text: This is AROS. It's made from a sentence.

onscreen: DAYS SINCE SOMEONE TRIED TO FIRE MAS: 90
FEB 22 · STUDIO MOGUL PUTS $800M EXPANSION ON HOLD AFTER SEEING AROS (REPORTED)

beats.caption: Nole's lawsuit rolls in: YOU PROMISED!!! Page one is all exclamation points. Mas reads the contents page too.
beats.vo: i only read page one. nothing in there surprised me.

beats.caption: INTRO (30 s). The cold-open line is one word, her, over a pulsing typing indicator. Then the filename card.
FEAR: RUMPT, just hands behind THE PODIUM, face never shown, pumps up a chatbot balloon: SO SCARY.
beats.real: 2024-02-02 · calls AI 'maybe the most dangerous thing out there'

beats.caption: THE EMAIL SÉANCE: by candlelight, on a Ouija board of reply chevrons, Mas summons Nole's 2016 emails.
onscreen: MAR 5 · NOPEAI PUBLISHES NOLE'S OLD EMAILS

beats.caption: Nole crashes through the ceiling. The planchette turns OPEN into NOPE. Three hands on it, one of them Mas's.
beats.vo: i didn't move it. i never touch the planchette.
onscreen: O · P · E · N → N · O · P · E

beats.caption: A Dec 2018 ghost says the quiet part and Nole disowns it. Then the last ghost rises: a draft with no body.

lines.text: "This needs billions per year immediately or forget it."

onscreen: DRAFT · NEVER SENT · Re: Why I'm leaving

beats.caption: F2.3 · FEB 20 2018: candle smoke opens Nole's goodbye all-hands. He leaves by a hatch; Mas watches it shut.
beats.vo: i didn't watch him leave. i was getting water.
onscreen: THE ROOM "DIDN'T ENTIRELY BUY THE STORY." (REPORTED)

beats.caption: DIRE's checkbook relights the candle; Nole takes it and leaves. MAR 8: Mas walks back to his board seat.
onscreen: MAR 8 · HIS CONDUCT "DID NOT MANDATE REMOVAL" · BACK ON THE BOARD (REPORTED)
beats.real: 2024-03-08 · review ends; Mas rejoins the board

beats.caption: NEYEL's 400-page RULEBOOK passes 523–46 and gets a SNOOZE button. Misanthropic's old stake sells for $884M.

lines.text: Article one: we are first. Article two: later.

onscreen: SOLD: $884M · PREVIOUS OWNER: THE OTHER MAS

beats.caption: XEL's mic grows on every pause. Mas denies tweeting about $7T; the rail says his chip plan was $5–7T.
beats.vo: technically true is my favourite kind of true.

beats.caption: ACT-OUT: the building splits open. THE HUMANIST moves into MACROSOFT's basement, under NopeAI. Mas looks down.

lines.text: Don't mind me. I'm just downstairs.
Rent is due on the first.

onscreen: MAR 19 · MACROSOFT STARTS ITS OWN AI UNIT, LED BY THE HUMANIST
beats.real: 2024-03-19 · Macrosoft launches its own AI unit

beats.caption: Podcast circuit: open-vs-closed tennis; TRAWETS lines up three CEOs; DIRE loses a debate to his own twin.

lines.text: My twin makes a fair point.

beats.caption: Backstage: CHATGTP answers before the question ends. Rima answers ahead too, and sends Mas to the wings.
THE PLAN: the old three-box relay drops tone and laughter through a grate. Now one box hears, sees, talks.

lines.text: Omni. One model that hears, sees and talks.

onscreen: OMNI: ONE MODEL THAT HEARS, SEES AND TALKS.
BEFORE: EAR → TEXT → MODEL → TEXT → MOUTH
NOW: EAR + EYE + MOUTH → ONE BOX

beats.caption: Three stamped steps. Then a tiny lowercase her drifts in from the margin. It was never on the plan. Rip.
onscreen: 1 ANSWER AS FAST AS A PERSON · 2 LAUNCH MONDAY · 3 GIVE IT TO FREE USERS

beats.caption: THE DEMO: CHATGTP grows ears, eyes and a mouth live, sings in three parts and fogs every pair of glasses.

lines.text: Hi! I can see you. …All of you.
You're making me blush. I don't have blood.

beats.caption: In the wings, Mas types one word, one letter a beat: h · e · r. Post. Every phone in the house lights up.
beats.vo: one word. nobody reads into one word.

beats.caption: The word swells into a lowercase blimp, blocks the stage lights, and Rima's spotlight swings onto it.
MIDPOINT: the front-row CHIEF SCIENTIST seat is empty. In its chrome armrest, Alyi's reflection turns away.
beats.vo: he'll be back. people come back. i did.

beats.caption: WHERE'S ALYI? point-and-click: Alyi only in reflections. Mas clicks 'come back' first. Greyed out. Bonk.
onscreen: > where are you going?  > was it the compute?  > come back

beats.caption: EKIEL quits past literally shiny products; dominoes land in Mas's glass. Alyi's 20% IOU flutters off.

lines.text: "safety culture and processes have taken a backseat to shiny products."

beats.vo: the compute was coming. it's basically in the mail.
onscreen: IOU: 20% COMPUTE · PLEDGED JUL 2023 · NEVER DELIVERED (REPORTED)

beats.caption: F2.2 · 2022 (Alyi's POV): Mas's dead TPOOL app pins LAST SEEN: 2022 · BONFIRE. An UNALIGNED effigy burns.
The holiday-party chant builds from one voice to all. The GPUs hum along. Alyi's eyes turn to token streams.
REMUHCS and three colleagues pose behind a bill-shaped lectern that won't fit through the door marked FLOOR.

lines.text: We'll hold a forum on it.

beats.caption: THE NDA ACROSS THE BAY BRIDGE: exit papers on receipt paper unroll lane by lane. Commuters read as they drive.
onscreen: MAY 17 · EXIT PAPERS: STAY QUIET OR LOSE YOUR EQUITY (REPORTED)
VESTED EQUITY: STOCK YOU ALREADY EARNED. (UNLESS.)

beats.caption: Mid-span, Mas stands on the unrolling papers. THE FORECASTER predicts a lowercase apology. Honks chop it.

lines.text: Median estimate: an apology. Within the hour. Lowercase.
"…i did not know this was happening…"

beats.vo: i didn't know. it was only as long as a bridge.

beats.caption: THE FORECASTER refuses to sign, tears his equity certificate in half, drops it off the bridge and walks away.
beats.real: 2024-05 · a researcher forfeits equity rather than sign

beats.caption: MAY 20: a letterhead storm cloud parks over the blimp and rains. It sags: PAUSED. Mas's glass: no ripple.
onscreen: MAY 20 · A LEGAL LETTER ARRIVES · NOPEAI PAUSES THE VOICE (REPORTED)
beats.real: 2024-05-20 · voice paused after a legal letter

beats.caption: ACT-OUT: his rain-beaded phone. VOICE 5 is greyed out like the 1993 Cancel. Bonk. A TPOOL alert slides down.
Split: ADELINA hangs a lanyard on EKIEL at the lighthouse; at NopeAI, TERB puts a SAFETY one on Mas.

lines.text: I have one concern. It's that we might win.

onscreen: MAY 28 · NOPEAI'S BOARD FORMS A SAFETY COMMITTEE. MAS IS ON IT. (REPORTED)
beats.real: 2024-05-28 · safety committee formed; EKIEL joins Misanthropic

beats.caption: Lobby movie night, ELPPA's keynote. New CFO HARAS trails calculator tape. Mas watches on his phone.
beats.vo: i didn't need to be up there. i've been up there.
onscreen: JUN 10 · NOPEAI HIRES ITS FIRST CFO
JUN 10 · CHATGTP IS COMING TO ELPPA'S PHONES

beats.caption: F2.1 · SEP 2006: a GPS breadcrumb crawls off the stream into a 16-colour phone ad. Young Mas, flip phone.
JUN 9 2008: Mas walks on at ELPPA's keynote in two popped collars; a faceless sleeve hands him the clicker.
beats.real: 2008-06-09 · TPOOL on the ELPPA keynote stage

beats.caption: THE WALLED GARDEN: MIT KOOC unlocks the one gate for CHATGTP. It shuts with Mas outside; a third collar pops.
zAI: Nole locks phones in a Faraday birdcage. One rings: caller ID MAS. Next day he drops his suit.

lines.text: My cat has a world model. And your AGI?

onscreen: JUN 10 · NOLE THREATENS TO BAN ELPPA DEVICES AT HIS COMPANIES (REPORTED)
JUN 11 · NOLE DROPS HIS STATE SUIT

beats.caption: Fog, only RUMPT's red tie: 'a superpower', 'alarming'. It clears to POPE SICNARF at the G7, played straight.

lines.text: Alarming. Who has the most? We should have the most.

onscreen: JUN 14 · "WE NEED TO ENSURE AND SAFEGUARD A SPACE FOR PROPER HUMAN CONTROL…"
beats.real: 2024-06-14 · first pope to address a G7

beats.caption: THE WHITE ROOM: a TPOOL pin drops on a flat white cube with one door and a NO doormat. Mas wipes his feet.
IOU under the door. Alyi's reflection faces Mas once; the door shuts. He raises a hand to knock, then doesn't.
beats.vo: i wasn't going to knock anyway.

beats.caption: The dark-room monitor, JUL 8: RUMPT's hands slide in a PLATFORM plank and tear the corner off NEDIB's order.
onscreen: JUL 8 · PARTY PLATFORM: "We will repeal EOJ NEDIB's dangerous Executive Order…"
beats.real: 2024-07-08 · platform promises to repeal the AI executive order

beats.caption: AUG 5: the refiled suit crashes through the skylight. The glass doesn't ripple. Fewer exclamation points.
onscreen: NOLE v. NOPEAI (+ MACROSOFT) · FEDERAL COURT

beats.caption: AUG 11: RUMPT falsely posts that SIRRAH 'A.I.'d' her crowd. THE ORB scans it face by face. No words.
beats.real: 2024-08-11 · false claim that a crowd photo was AI-made

beats.caption: AUG 16: ISOLEP pats an egg on a bill, then nudges it off. It hatches a one-headed hydra labelled 1047.
onscreen: AUG 16 · ISOLEP: "…SB 1047 IS WELL-INTENTIONED BUT ILL INFORMED."

beats.caption: BUTTON, AUG 18–22: RUMPT's hands post 'I accept!' over six-fingered AI fans, then tie SO SCARY to THE PODIUM.
beats.vo: i'm just watching. none of this is about me.

beats.caption: HOOK: THE PODIUM creaks and turns toward us by one pixel. A sticky note on its back: LATER. Cut to black.
